paragraphs: Atlantic Management Center, Inc., which the site shortens to AMCI, sells customized software solutions. It pairs that software with what it calls Learning Capability Services.

The company groups its offerings into learning services and public health modules meant to help client organizations perform better. One of those offerings is described as a companion IIS product that supports a health agency's daily workflows. Separately, the site invites visitors to look at training meant to advance their own careers.

The audience is health care, with the site framing its products and services as ways to advance health care responses. Beyond the corporate name in its copyright line, the page states nothing about the company's founding, size, funding or customers.

quote.text: Complementary IIS software solution to assist with daily workflows
